[ 3 ]
[ What is hiring? ]
…but nobody moves through it in a line.
SOURCE
SCREEN
ONSITE
OFFER
ACCEPT
BOUNCE
Candidates skip ahead, stall for weeks, and drop out at every stage.
FALSE NEGATIVES / POSITIVES
Candidates might need to go backwards to avoid mishiring… or missing out on a great person.
TIME IS A FRIENDLY FOE
Isn't it crazy that we make decisions that affect us for years after just a few hours with the team? We are all busy, so we optimize for less time here… often wrongly. Don't be afraid to increase time in each stage so a candidate feels valued, comfortable, and familiar with us.
Copyright Dobromir Montauk, 2026

[ What is hiring? ]
Every part of the funnel is a different filter.
SOURCE
→ Are they on the market?
RECRUITER SCREEN
→ Would they ever even choose us?
EM SCREEN
→ Will they be excited about us?
TECH SCREEN
→ Are they likely to be a good engineer?
ONSITE
→ Are they a GREAT engineer?
→ Will they thrive at Mashgin?
OFFER
→ Will they choose US over the competition?

SOURCE
← Does Mashgin seem like an interesting company / problem / technology / team / whatever I care about…?

← Who are these people? What is their “culture”?
EM SCREEN

ONSITE

[ Two dimensions ]
Strength × Fit

Candidates want top-right companies.

[ 8 ]
[ Strength ]
Defining “Strength”: A, B, C, D players
A
B
C
D
90% likely to solve the problems you throw at them.
75% likely to solve the problems you throw at them.
60% likely to FAIL. Why risk it?
Lowers team productivity, drives away key talent, degrades the codebase.
HOW THEY AFFECT OTHERS ↓
Attracts other A players.
Can irritate A players.
Drives away A players.
Gets you fired.
* Depends on the role → an A player in one role might be a D player in another!

[ 19 ]
[ Resolve before hiring: Mercenaries ]
Give them some pain.
CHALLENGE
World View
MAKE IT REAL
Lower Pay
COLD SPLASH
Title Shrink
How they react tells you how they think about the role. (You can always walk it back later.)
Copyright Dobromir Montauk, 2026
[ 20 ]
[ Resolve before hiring: B Players ]
Was it THEM, or their environment?
RE-INTERVIEW
Missed Strengths
LACKED OPPORTUNITY
Challenging Onboarding
WRONG MENTORSHIP
Pair with Your Best
A B on paper can be opportunity and coaching, not ability.
